name: nubloxsql
description: One NuBloxSQL entry point for multi-dialect SQL database integration.
author: Stephen J T Spittal

scripts.test:mysql: node lib/dialects/mysql/test/protocol.js && node lib/dialects/mysql/test/auth.js && node lib/dialects/mysql/test/prepared.js && node lib/dialects/mysql/test/api.js && node lib/dialects/mysql/test/session-reset.js && node lib/dialects/mysql/test/streaming.js && node lib/dialects/mysql/test/operation-control.js && node lib/dialects/mysql/test/dialect.js && node lib/dialects/mysql/test/package.js
scripts.test:sql-core: node lib/core/test/contract.js && node test/dialect-contracts.js && node test/sql-core-v1-contract.js
scripts.test:postgresql: node lib/dialects/postgresql/test/contract.js && node lib/dialects/postgresql/test/protocol.js && node lib/dialects/postgresql/test/runtime.js && node lib/dialects/postgresql/test/lifecycle.js && node lib/dialects/postgresql/test/cancel.js && node lib/dialects/postgresql/test/pool-transaction.js && node lib/dialects/postgresql/test/portal.js && node lib/dialects/postgresql/test/result-limits.js && node lib/dialects/postgresql/test/type-decoding.js
scripts.verify: npm run test:platform && npm run test:mysql && npm run test:sql-core && npm run test:postgresql && npm run test:sqlite
scripts.verify:proprietary: npm run verify && npm run v1:proprietary-audit && npm run v1:release-audit
